You are being evaluated on Continual-ARC, a lifelong stream of ARC-style grid puzzles.
Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import json
G=load()
def f(g):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    mc=min((c for _,_,c in [(i,j,g[i][j]) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]!=bg]),
           key=lambda c:sum(1 for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==c))
    pts=sorted((i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==mc)
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for ep in pts+[pts[0]]:
        pass
    # perpendicular slope: marker is slope +/-1; draw full line slope opposite through each endpoint, skip marker cells
    for ep in pts:
        for d in ((1,1),(-1,-1)):
            r,c=ep[0]+d[0],ep[1]+d[1]; k=0
            while 0<=r<H and 0<=c<W and g[r][c]==bg:
                k+=1; r+=d[0]; c+=d[1]
            # only accept if contiguous from endpoint
            break
    # simpler: full line through each endpoint, direction chosen so line doesn't overlap marker beyond endpoint
    for ep in pts:
        # try both dirs, keep longest contiguous run starting at next cell of endpoint
        best=None
        for d in ((1,1),(-1,-1)):
            r,c=ep[0]+d[0],ep[1]+d[1]; k=0
            while 0<=r<H and 0<=c<W and g[r][c]==bg:
                k+=1; r+=d[0]; c+=d[1]
            if best is None or k>best[0]: best=(k,d)
        if best:
            k,d=best
            r,c=ep[0]+d[0],ep[1]+d[1]
            for _ in range(k): out[r][c]=3; r+=d[0]; c+=d[1]
    return out
print(f(G['Demo pair 1 input'])==G['Demo pair 1 output'])
print(f(G['Demo pair 2 input'])==G['Demo pair 2 output'])
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))

import json
from collections import Counter

def f(gi):
    g=[r[:] for r in gi]; H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    marker=min((c for c in cnt if c!=0), key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    pts=sorted((i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==marker)
    bg=max(c for c in cnt if c not in (marker,0))
    a,b=pts[0],pts[-1]
    v=(b[0]-a[0], b[1]-a[1]); L=max(abs(v[0]),abs(v[1])); v=(v[0]//L,v[1]//L)
    pd=[(v[1],-v[0]),(-v[1],v[0])]
    res=[r[:] for r in g]; best=None
    for ep in pts:
        for d in pd:
            run=[]; i,j=ep[0]+d[0], ep[1]+d[1]
            while 0<=i<H and 0<=j<W and g[i][j]!=marker:
                run.append((i,j)); i+=d[0]; j+=d[1]
            reach=max(i+j for i,j in run)
            cand=(len(run),reach,ep,d)
            if best is None or cand>(best[0],best[1]): best=cand
    for (i,j) in best[3]: res[i][j]=3
    return res

def f3(gi):
    g=[r[:] for r in gi]; H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    marker=min((c for c in cnt if c!=0), key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    pts=sorted((i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==marker)
    bg=max(c for c in cnt if c not in (marker,0))
    res=[r[:] for r in g]
    v=(pts[-1][0]-pts[0][0], pts[-1][1]-pts[0][1]); L=max(abs(v[0]),abs(v[1])); v=(v[0]//L,v[1]//L)
    pd=[(v[1],-v[0]),(-v[1],v[0])]
    best=None
    for ep in pts:
        vp=(ep[0]-0.5*(pts[0][0]+pts[-1][0]), ep[1]-0.5*(pts[0][1]+pts[-1][1]))
        d=d0= None
        for d in pd:
            if round(d[0]*vp[0]+d[1]*vp[1],6)>0:
                run=[]; i,j=ep[0]+d[0], ep[1]+d[1]
                while 0<=i<H and 0<=j<W and g[i][j]!=marker:
                    run.append((i,j)); i+=d[0]; j+=d[1]
                cand=(len(run),run,d)
                if best is None or cand>best: best=cand
    for (i,j) in best[1]: res[i][j]=3
    return res

steps.input:
import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]

def f(gi):
    g=[r[:] for r in gi]; H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    marker=min((c for c in cnt if c!=0), key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    pts=sorted((i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==marker)
    bg=max(c for c in cnt if c not in (marker,0))
    res=[r[:] for r in g]; best=None
    for ep in pts:
        for d in [(1,1),(-1,-1),(1,-1),(-1,1)]:
            run=[]; i,j=ep[0]+d[0],ep[1]+d[1]
            while 0<=i<H and 0<=j<W and g[i][j]!=marker:
                run.append((i,j)); i+=d[0]; j+=d[1]
            cand=(len(run),run,d)
            if best is None or cand>best: best=cand
    for (i,j) in best[1]: res[i][j]=3
    return res

print([f(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'] for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']])
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]

def f(gi):
    g=[r[:] for r in gi]; H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    marker=min((c for c in cnt if c!=0), key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    pts=sorted((i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==marker)
    bg=max(c for c in cnt if c not in (marker,0))
    res=[r[:] for r in g]; best=None
    a,b=pts[0],pts[-1]
    v=(b[0]-a[0], b[1]-a[1]); L=max(abs(v[0]),abs(v[1])); v=(v[0]//L,v[1]//L)
    pd=[(v[1],-v[0]),(-v[1],v[0])]
    for ep in pts:
        for d in pd:
            vp=(ep[0]-0.5*(a[0]+b[0]), ep[1]-0.5*(a[1]+b[1]))
            if round(d[0]*vp[0]+d[1]*vp[1],6)<=0: continue
            run=[]; i,j=ep[0]+d[0],ep[1]+d[1]
            while 0<=i<H and 0<=j<W and g[i][j]!=marker:
                run.append((i,j)); i+=d[0]; j+=d[1]
            cand=(len(run),run,d,ep)
            if best is None or cand>best: best=cand
    for (i,j) in best[1]: res[i][j]=3
    return res

print([f(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'] for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']])
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]

def f(gi):
    g=[r[:] for r in gi]; H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    marker=min((c for c in cnt if c!=0), key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    pts=sorted((i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==marker)
    bg=max(c for c in cnt if c not in (marker,0))
    res=[r[:] for r in g]; best=None
    a,b=pts[0],pts[-1]
    v=(b[0]-a[0], b[1]-a[1]); L=max(abs(v[0]),abs(v[1])); v=(v[0]//L,v[1]//L)
    # perpendicular unit dirs
    pd=[(v[1],-v[0]),(-v[1],v[0])]
    mcnt=sum(i+j for i,j in pts)/len(pts)
    for d in pd:
        # line through each marker cell, both dirs along the perp axis
        for ep in pts:
            for sgn in (1,-1):
                run=[]; i,j=ep[0]+sgn*d[0], ep[1]+sgn*d[1]
                while 0<=i<H and 0<=j<W and g[i][j]==bg:
                    run.append((i,j)); i+=d[0]; j+=d[1]
                dist=abs(ep[0]+sgn*d[0]+ep[1]+sgn*d[1]-mcnt) if False else abs(sgn*(ep[0]+ep[1]-2*mcnt)) if d[0]==d[1] else 0
                cand=(len(run), -dist, run)
                if best is None or cand>best: best=cand
    for (i,j) in (best[2] if best else []): res[i][j]=3
    return res

print([f(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'] for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']])
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))

def f(gi):
    g=[r[:] for r in gi]; H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=max(cnt, key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    marker=min((c for c in cnt if c!=bg), key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    pts=sorted((i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==marker)
    a,b=pts[0],pts[-1]
    v=(b[0]-a[0],b[1]-a[1]); L=max(abs(v[0]),abs(v[1])); v=(v[0]//L,v[1]//L)
    res=[r[:] for r in g]; best=None
    for ep in (a,b):
        for d in ((v[1],-v[0]),(-v[1],v[0])):
            run=[]; i,j=ep[0]+d[0],ep[1]+d[1]
            while 0<=i<H and 0<=j<W:
                if g[i][j]==bg: run.append((i,j))
                i+=d[0]; j+=d[1]
            cand=(len(run),run,d)
            if best is None or cand>best: best=cand
    for (i,j) in best[1]: res[i][j]=3
    return res

print([f(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'] for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']])

from collections import Counter
import json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        seg=t[m.end():]
        rows=[]
        for line in seg.split('\n'):
            nums=line.split()
            if len(nums)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in nums):
                rows.append([int(x) for x in nums])
        if len(rows)>=h: G[k]=rows[:h]
    return G
G=load()
def solve(gi):
    g=[r[:] for r in gi]; H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    others=[c for c in cnt if c!=bg]; marker=min(others,key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    pts=sorted((i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==marker)
    a,b=pts[0],pts[-1]
    dx=b[0]-a[0]; dy=b[1]-a[1]; L=max(abs(dx),abs(dy)) or 1
    ux,uy=dx//L,dy//L   # direction from first to last marker
    res=[r[:] for r in g]
    for E in (a,b):
        O=b if E==a else a
        for sgn in (1,-1):
            P=(E[0]+sgn*ux, E[1]+sgn*uy)
            if not (0<=P[0]<H and 0<=P[1]<W) or g[P[0]][P[1]]!=bg: continue
            i,j=P[0],P[1]
            while 0<=i<H and 0<=j<W and g[i][j]==bg:
                res[i][j]=3; i+=sgn*ux; j+=sgn*uy
    return res

gt=solve(G['Test input']); print(json.dumps(gt)); print(sorted((i,j) for i in range(len(gt)) for j in range(len(gt[0])) if gt[i][j]==3))
